Routing observations:

- Option C (“regional office”) is valid for south-region claims (both small and large observed).
- Option C is also valid for a large south-region shipment.
- Option C is not valid for south-region refunds, regardless of size.
- Option C was rejected for every east-region request observed (invoices and refunds, small and large).
- For future tickets, do not choose C solely because the request came through a regional office or mentions the south; request type matters.
- Current evidence supports C for south claims and possibly south shipments, but not south refunds or east-region requests. No evidence yet distinguishes A vs. B for cases where C is invalid.

Routing observations:

- Request type and region matter; do not choose C solely because a ticket mentions a regional office or the south.
- C is valid for observed south claims (small and large) and south large shipments.
- C is invalid for south refunds and all observed east-region requests. No evidence yet for C on north requests.
- A is valid for:
  - north small invoices;
  - east small shipments;
  - east small refunds.
- A is invalid for:
  - south small refunds;
  - north small refunds;
  - north small refunds (second observation);
  - east large claims.
- B is invalid for:
  - north small claims;
  - north large refunds.
- The north refund observations eliminate A and B, so C is the remaining likely valid option for north refunds, though C has not been directly tested there.
- For east large claims, C is already unsupported and A was rejected; B is therefore the remaining likely option.
- For south refunds, A and C are invalid, making B the likely option.
- North small claims have B rejected; A versus C remains unresolved.
- Size may matter, especially for claims and refunds. No reliable rule yet distinguishes A from B/C in all untested combinations.

Routing observations:

- Region, request type, and size matter; do not infer from sender or wording.
- Confirmed valid:
  - C: south small/large shipments; south small/large claims; north small refunds; east large claims; north large claims.
  - A: north small invoices; north large shipments.
  - B: south refunds (inferred, but see conflict below); south large invoices; east large shipments.
- Confirmed invalid:
  - C: south refunds; south large invoices; all previously observed east requests except east large claims; north large shipments.
  - A: south small refunds; north small refunds; south small shipments; east small shipments; east small refunds; east large claims; north large claims; south large invoices.
  - B: north small claims; north large refunds/claims/shipments; east large claims; south small refunds; east small refunds.
- New unresolved cases:
  - North small claims: B invalid; A versus C.
  - East small shipments: A invalid; B versus C.
  - East small claims: B invalid; A versus C.
- North small shipment: B accepted; no alternatives established.
- East large shipment: B accepted.
- South large claim: C confirmed again.
- South small refund has contradictory evidence: A and C were previously invalid, but B was also rejected. Do not assume a valid option until re-tested; records may contain an inconsistency.
- East small refund: A and B invalid, so C is the remaining candidate, but not directly confirmed.
- No reliable general rule maps every combination; size remains important, especially for claims and refunds.

Routing observations:

- Route by region, request type, and size; ignore sender and wording. Size matters, especially for claims/refunds. No universal rule established.
- Confirmed valid:
  - C: south small/large shipments; south small/large claims; north small claims; east large claims.
  - A: north small invoices; north large invoices; north large shipments.
  - B: south refunds (historically inferred); south large invoices; east large shipments/invoices; east small shipments; north small shipments.
- Confirmed invalid:
  - C: south refunds; south large invoices; north large refunds; north small refunds; all previously observed east requests except east large claims.
  - A: south small refunds/shipments; north small refunds; north large claims/shipments; east small shipments/claims; east small refunds; east large claims; south large invoices.
  - B: north small claims; north large refunds/claims; east large claims; south small refunds; east small refunds.
- Current remaining candidates (not directly confirmed):
  - North small refund: B only (A and C invalid).
  - East small claim: C only (A and B invalid).
  - East small refund: C only (A and B invalid).
- South small refund remains inconsistent: A, B, and C have each been rejected in the records. Do not assume a route; re-test or flag the data.
- Recent confirmations: north small claim C; north small shipment B; south large shipment C; east small shipment B; east large invoice B; north large invoice A; south large claim C.

Routing observations:

- Route by region, request type, and size; sender and wording appear irrelevant. Size matters. No universal rule beyond the observed matrix.
- Confirmed valid:
  - C: south small/large shipments; south small/large claims; north small/large claims; east small claims; east large claims.
  - A: north small/large invoices.
  - B: south large invoices (historical confirmation, now contradicted below); east large shipments/invoices; east small shipments; north small shipments.
- Confirmed invalid:
  - C: south refunds; south large invoices; north small/large refunds; all observed east requests except east small claims and east large claims.
  - A: south small refunds/shipments; south large invoices; north small refunds; north large claims/shipments; east small shipments/claims/refunds; east large claims.
  - B: north small claims; north small refunds; north large refunds/claims; east large claims; south small refunds; east small refunds; south small invoice; south large refund; south large invoice.
- New confirmations: north large claim C; east small claim C; north small claim C; north small shipment B; south large shipment/claim C; east small shipment B; east large invoice B; north large invoice A.
- Data inconsistencies / unresolved:
  - North small refund: A, B, and C all rejected; flag rather than route.
  - South small refund: A, B, and C all rejected; flag.
  - South large invoice: A, B, and C all rejected despite prior historical B confirmation; flag and treat prior record as contradicted.
  - South large refund: B rejected; A/C remain unconfirmed.
  - South small invoice: B rejected; A/C remain unconfirmed.

Routing notes:

- Route by region, request type, and size; sender/wording appear irrelevant. Use only confirmed matrix entries. If all known options are rejected or no valid option is confirmed, flag rather than guess.

Confirmed valid:
- C: south small/large shipments; south small/large claims; north small/large claims; east small/large claims.
- A: north small/large invoices.
- B: east small/large invoices; east small shipments.
- Historical B confirmation for south large invoices is contradicted—do not use.

Confirmed invalid:
- C: south refunds; south large invoices; north small/large refunds; observed east requests except east small/large claims.
- A: south small refunds/shipments; south large invoices; north small refunds; north large claims/shipments; east small shipments/claims/refunds; east large claims.
- B: north small claims/refunds; north large refunds/claims; east large claims; south small refunds; east small refunds; south small invoice; south large refund/invoice; north small shipment; north large shipment.
- D is not a valid option (east small refund attempt).

Unresolved/flag:
- North small refund: A/B/C rejected.
- South small refund: A/B/C rejected.
- South large invoice: A/B/C rejected; prior B record is invalidated.
- North large refund: A rejected; B/C unconfirmed.
- South large refund: B rejected; A/C unconfirmed.
- South small invoice: B rejected; A/C unconfirmed.
- East small refund: A/B/C not confirmed; D invalid.
- North small shipment: prior B confirmation is contradicted by rejection; no valid option currently confirmed.
- North large shipment: B rejected; no valid option currently confirmed.
